maria: CI on main is red after the merge — failing only in the python wheel job: tests/test_integration_embeddings.py::TestCLI::test_streaming. Other axes (docker, e2e) look green. Can someone do a surgical bounce that avoids rebuilding images? Link: https://ci.redwood/example/12345

aj: yep looks isolated to wheel-py38. We can retrigger just that job and skip image builds. Use the CI bot command: `@CI-Bot rerun --job=wheel-py38 --rebuild-images=false`

devops: fyi the internal shortcut is also available: `/ci rerun wheel-py38 --env REBUILD_IMAGES=false` (same effect). If it's really cache-related add `--clean-cache`

maria: thanks — trying the bot command now

CI-Bot: Accepted: rerun queued for wheel-py38 with REBUILD_IMAGES=false. Build URL: https://ci.redwood/example/12345/attempt-2 :rocket:

ryan: if it still flakes, best to rerun with `--clean-cache` so pip reinstall happens; sometimes our wheel cache hides regressions. Command example:
```
@CI-Bot rerun --job=wheel-py38 --rebuild-images=false --clean-cache
```

maria: the targeted rerun is running. keeping this thread in case we need to escalate to eng-oncall @eng-oncall

CI-Bot: wheel-py38 attempt-2 finished: ✅ passed (no image rebuild). Logs: https://ci.redwood/example/12345/attempt-2/logs

maria: nice, green. thanks all — filing a follow-up to add a note to the test to reduce flakiness. cc @aj

aj: sweet. if it recurs we'll bisect, but for now surgical rerun did the trick :thumbsup:
